2026-09-04FIN, GACCustoms TariffOrder Amending the United States Surtax Order (Steel and Aluminum 2025)Order Amending the United States Surtax Order (Steel and Aluminum 2025) in order to (1) increase the counter-tariff rate for most steel and aluminum goods that were previously subject to a rate of 25 percent to 50 percent; and (2) apply the counter-tariffs in addition to any applicable customs duty imposed and only to those goods originating in the U.S. already in transit to Canada on or before September 8 would be exempted.Registration: SOR/2026-0187 Publication Date: 2026-09-23
subject: Order Amending the United States Surtax Order (Steel and Aluminum 2025)
precis: Order Amending the United States Surtax Order (Steel and Aluminum 2025) in order to (1) increase the counter-tariff rate for most steel and aluminum goods that were previously subject to a rate of 25 percent to 50 percent; and (2) apply the counter-tariffs in addition to any applicable customs duty imposed and only to those goods originating in the U.S. already in transit to Canada on or before September 8 would be exempted.
